description: Record what the owner chose, the options considered (best-ranked first), what they passed over and why. Passing over the top option needs a reason. Returns a line for decisions.jsonl and, if a durable rule was stated, a learning candidate with where to save it.

decision.description: considered is best-ranked first; passing over the top option needs a rationale.

by.description: "owner", only after the owner actually said so.

engagement.description: The complete engagement.json from the last outcome tool result, unchanged.

engagement_sha256.description: engagement_sha256 from the last outcome tool result. A different value means the engagement changed.
